sections.title: League Format
rules: 10-team private league on ESPN Fantasy Basketball.
Head-to-head (H2H) Each Category scoring format — 9 categories per week.
Regular season runs from Week 1 through Week 21.
Top 6 teams qualify for playoffs (Weeks 22–24).
Each week matchup runs Monday through Sunday.

sections.title: Scoring Categories
rules: Points (PTS)
Rebounds (REB)
Assists (AST)
Steals (STL)
Blocks (BLK)
3-Pointers Made (3PM)
Field Goal % (FG%) — minimum 15 attempts
Free Throw % (FT%) — minimum 10 attempts
Turnovers (TO) — lower is better

sections.title: Roster
rules: 13 active roster spots per team.
Positions: PG, SG, SF, PF, C, G, F, UTIL, UTIL, BN, BN, BN, BN.
2 Injured Reserve (IR) spots available.
A player placed on IR must have official IR/IL status.
Daily lineup changes allowed — lock at game start time.

sections.title: Draft
rules: Live snake draft before the season starts.
Draft order determined by reverse standings from previous season.
New managers (first season) pick randomly within the bottom half.
15 rounds, 10 picks per round = 150 total picks.
Each pick has a 90-second clock during live draft.

sections.title: Transactions & Waivers
rules: Waiver claims process every Wednesday morning at 5:00 AM.
Waiver priority resets using Continual Rolling List (CRL) order.
Free agents (post-waiver) can be picked up at any time.
Maximum 100 transactions per season per team.
Trades must be accepted within 48 hours or they expire.
2-day trade review period — league can veto by majority vote.

sections.title: Playoffs
rules: Top 6 teams enter playoffs after Week 21.
Seeds 1 and 2 receive a first-round bye.
Bracket: (3v6) and (4v5) in Week 22, winners face 1 and 2 in Week 23.
Championship in Week 24.
Playoff seeding determined by regular season record, then total points.
No trades allowed after Week 19 (trade deadline).

sections.title: Prizes
rules: Entry fee: ₪120 per team.
Total pot: ₪1,200.
1st place: ₪800.
2nd place: ₪400.
3rd place (consolation bracket winner): ₪200 from side contributions.
Last place (regular season): Must buy the group dinner — date TBD.
Weekly high score bonus: ₪20 per week (optional, must be agreed pre-season).

sections.title: Code of Conduct
rules: Collusion of any kind results in immediate disqualification.
Tanking (intentionally losing) is prohibited — must start a legal lineup each week.
A legal lineup means all active roster spots filled (no empty slots).
Trash talk in the group chat is encouraged — be cool about it.
Any disputes go to a majority vote among all league members.
Commissioner's ruling is final in edge cases.
